title: Code name casing
responsibility: Converts names into kebab, Pascal, camel or snake case using the same word boundaries.

inputs.name: toKebabCase.textToConvert
inputs.description: The text whose casing and separator characters decide where the kebab-case words split. Only ASCII letters and digits form words, any other character ends a word, and a lowercase letter or digit followed by an uppercase letter starts a new word, so HTTPResponse stays one word.

inputs.name: toPascalCase.textToConvert
inputs.description: The text whose casing and separator characters decide the words, each of which is lowercased and then given an uppercase first character. Only ASCII letters and digits form words, any other character ends a word, and a lowercase letter or digit followed by an uppercase letter starts a new word, so HTTPResponse stays one word.

inputs.name: toCamelCase.textToConvert
inputs.description: The text whose casing and separator characters decide the words that form the Pascal result before its first character is lowercased. Only ASCII letters and digits form words, any other character ends a word, and a lowercase letter or digit followed by an uppercase letter starts a new word, so HTTPResponse stays one word.

inputs.name: toSnakeCase.textToConvert
inputs.description: The text whose casing and separator characters decide where the snake_case words split. Only ASCII letters and digits form words, any other character ends a word, and a lowercase letter or digit followed by an uppercase letter starts a new word, so HTTPResponse stays one word.

outputs.name: toKebabCase.kebabCaseText
outputs.description: The lowercase words of the input joined with hyphens and no leading or trailing hyphen. It is an empty string when the input has no ASCII letters or digits, such as an empty input or one made only of separators.

outputs.name: toPascalCase.pascalCaseText
outputs.description: The lowercase words of the input joined with no separator, each with its first character uppercased (a word that starts with a digit is unchanged). It is an empty string when the input has no ASCII letters or digits, such as an empty input or one made only of separators.

outputs.name: toCamelCase.camelCaseText
outputs.description: The words of the input joined with no separator, where the first word is lowercase and each later word has its first character uppercased. It is an empty string when the input has no ASCII letters or digits, such as an empty input or one made only of separators.

outputs.name: toSnakeCase.snakeCaseText
outputs.description: The lowercase words of the input joined with underscores and no leading or trailing underscore. It is an empty string when the input has no ASCII letters or digits, such as an empty input or one made only of separators.
